summary: Adds the Plex.tv-backed multi-account monitor adapter and bounded media health probes to the generated Plex CLI.
reason: The existing monitor contract must remain available while Plex-specific discovery, credential isolation, and media-byte verification are exposed through the generated CLI's novel-command hook.
validated_outcome: Generated CLI and MCP tree builds and tests; serve preserves /plex/<account>/<server> status semantics and is deployed behind the existing plexctl-monitor:3003 service boundary without changing Kuma monitor records.
